status: POST-HOC and exploratory. Written after the first build was inspected. It does not replace the frozen columns; it adds a separate file, hebrew_check_v2.csv. Both are reported.
reason: The frozen Hebrew patterns match inside other words. 'בור' (cistern) matches inside 'קבורה' (burial); 'מער' (cave) matches inside 'מערב' (west); 'באר' (well) matches inside 'בארץ' (in the land). So the frozen heb_only_classes and heb_confirms columns over-report cistern, cave and spring_well.
rule: A pattern counts only as a whole Hebrew word: no Hebrew letter immediately before it, except up to two one-letter prefixes from ה ו ב ל מ ש כ, and no Hebrew letter after the listed endings. Applied to the same Hebrew description and finding text of each site.
output: hebrew_check_v2.csv: record_id, asi_map_id, site_num, classes_he_v2, heb_only_v2 (v2 classes absent from the English classes of the same site). It never creates a features.csv row and never changes looks_asi.csv.
